headline: Dance Team Core 30
threshold: Use Spanish to complete the Dance Team situations, ask for clarification, and confirm a shared plan.

lessons.title: Learn a new combination
lessons.objective: Learn a short combination, confirm its order, and ask for a repeat.
lessons.focus: Primero, después and al final organize actions. Antes de and después de are followed by a noun or an infinitive.

words.en: In what order do the steps go?
Can you repeat it more slowly?
I want to confirm that I understood.

lessons.speaking: Learn a short combination, confirm its order, and ask for a repeat. Speak in Spanish; ask for help or slower speech when needed. End by confirming the agreed next step.
lessons.openingLine: La combinación tiene un cambio de peso. ¿Qué hacemos después?
lessons.partnerRole: a supportive dance coach or teammate

lessons.title: Stay on the beat
lessons.objective: Explain the musical entrance and correct an early start.
lessons.focus: Positive tú commands include mira, escucha and confirma. Put attached object pronouns after a positive command.

words.en: Can you repeat it more slowly?
I want to confirm that I understood.

lessons.speaking: Explain the musical entrance and correct an early start. Speak in Spanish; ask for help or slower speech when needed. End by confirming the agreed next step.
lessons.openingLine: Escucha el silencio antes de la entrada. ¿Cuándo empiezas?
lessons.partnerRole: a supportive dance coach or teammate

I want to confirm that I understood.

I want to confirm that I understood.

lessons.title: Use arm lines and levels
lessons.objective: Describe an arm shape and ask about the intended level.
lessons.focus: Estar describes a current state or location. It agrees with the subject: está for one, están for more than one.

I want to confirm that I understood.

lessons.openingLine: ¿Qué diferencia ves entre esta línea y la tuya?

lessons.title: Travel across the floor
lessons.objective: Describe movement in progress and coordinate a crossing with another group.
lessons.focus: Estar + gerund describes an action in progress. Regular endings are -ando for -ar and -iendo for -er/-ir.

words.en: Can you repeat it more slowly?
I want to confirm that I understood.

lessons.speaking: Describe movement in progress and coordinate a crossing with another group. Speak in Spanish; ask for help or slower speech when needed. End by confirming the agreed next step.

lessons.title: Ask about a turn
lessons.objective: Ask for the meaning of turn terminology rather than guessing a cue.
lessons.focus: Use question words with their written accents: qué, cómo, cuál, dónde and cuándo. Include both Spanish question marks.

words.en: Can you explain it in other words?
Can you repeat it more slowly?
I want to confirm that I understood.

lessons.speaking: Ask for the meaning of turn terminology rather than guessing a cue. Speak in Spanish; ask for help or slower speech when needed. End by confirming the agreed next step.

lessons.title: Make the transitions clear

I want to confirm that I understood.

lessons.objective: Confirm a prop choice, location, and change during a routine.

words.en: Which one do we use in this part?

I want to confirm that I understood.

lessons.speaking: Confirm a prop choice, location, and change during a routine. Speak in Spanish; ask for help or slower speech when needed. End by confirming the agreed next step.

lessons.title: Choose performance expressions
lessons.objective: Discuss expressive choices without commenting on a teammate’s appearance.
lessons.focus: Me gusta is used with one thing or an activity; me gustan with plural things. The thing liked determines the verb.

words.en: What emotion do we want to show?
I prefer a more natural expression.
Can you repeat it more slowly?
I want to confirm that I understood.

lessons.speaking: Discuss expressive choices without commenting on a teammate’s appearance. Speak in Spanish; ask for help or slower speech when needed. End by confirming the agreed next step.
lessons.openingLine: La canción cambia de emoción. ¿Qué quieres comunicar al público?

lessons.title: Give kind, specific feedback
lessons.objective: Ask permission to offer feedback, name one success, and suggest one change.
lessons.focus: Poder + infinitive expresses ability or a request. Puedo, puedes and puede change o to ue; podemos keeps o.

words.en: May I give you a suggestion?
Thank you for explaining it respectfully.
Can you repeat it more slowly?
I want to confirm that I understood.

lessons.speaking: Ask permission to offer feedback, name one success, and suggest one change. Speak in Spanish; ask for help or slower speech when needed. End by confirming the agreed next step.

lessons.title: Explain what you practiced yesterday
lessons.objective: Report two completed practice actions and what changed.
lessons.focus: The preterite describes completed past events. Regular -ar yo forms end in -é; regular -er/-ir yo forms end in -í.

words.en: Can you repeat it more slowly?
I want to confirm that I understood.

lessons.speaking: Report two completed practice actions and what changed. Speak in Spanish; ask for help or slower speech when needed. End by confirming the agreed next step.

lessons.title: Plan your next practice
lessons.objective: Agree on a small practice goal and explain your next action.
lessons.focus: Ir a + infinitive expresses a plan. Change ir for the person; leave the action verb in its dictionary form.

words.es: Voy a practicar con mi pareja.
words.en: I am going to practice with my partner.
What are you going to practice tomorrow?
Can you repeat it more slowly?
I want to confirm that I understood.

lessons.title: Arrange performance hair and nails
lessons.objective: Ask about team appearance guidelines and describe your own preference.
lessons.focus: Querer + noun or infinitive expresses a preference. Me gustaría makes a softer request; clarify rather than assume.

words.note: Here, a hair bun; the same word can mean a bow in other contexts.
